text-[1.5em]" style="line-height:1.3" data-anchor="whatilearnedfromtesting7aiappbuilders" data-slug="whatilearnedfromtesting7aiappbuilders166"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" class="w-full my-[1px]"><div data-slate-node="element" class="py-[3px]"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">After running the same Solace Studio prompt through all seven platforms, several patterns emerged that go beyond individual platform features. These are the things I wish someone had told me before I started.</span></span></span></div></div><div class="w-full mt-[1em] mb-[1px]"><h3 data-slate-node="element" class="font-[600] py-[3px] text-[1.25em]" style="line-height:1.3" data-anchor="thefrontendbackendgapistherealstory" data-slug="thefrontendbackendgapistherealstory168"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">The Frontend-Backend Gap Is the Real Story</span></span></span></h3></div><div class="w-full my-[1px]"><div data-slate-node="element" class="py-[3px]"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">The most revealing finding across all platforms: almost every tool could generate a good-looking frontend. Lovable, Base44, Bubble, and Figma all produced polished mobile UIs with service catalogs, navigation, and modern design that matched the &quot;soft neutrals&quot; brief. But the hard stuff, such as Stripe payments, the 48-hour cancellation policy with tiered refunds, double-booking prevention, automated emails, push notification scheduling, and a functional admin panel, are separated the platforms dramatically. Manus delivered these from a single prompt. Most others surfaced them as &quot;next steps&quot; or required manual building.</span></span></span></div></div><div class="w-full mt-[1em] mb-[1px]"><h3 data-slate-node="element" class="font-[600] py-[3px] text-[1.25em]" style="line-height:1.3" data-anchor="%22aigenerated%22stillmostlymeans%22frontendgenerated%22" data-slug="%22aigenerated%22stillmostlymeans%22frontendgenerated%22170"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">&quot;AI-Generated&quot; Still Mostly Means &quot;Frontend-Generated&quot;</span></span></span></h3></div><div class="w-full my-[1px]"><div data-slate-node="element" class="py-[3px]"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">A lot of platforms produce impressive-looking screenshots. But when you test whether the booking calendar actually prevents double-bookings, or whether the cancellation logic actually calculates a 50% fee—that&#x27;s where most AI builders fall short. Lovable was transparent about this, surfacing &quot;Integrate Stripe Payments&quot; and &quot;Add Push Notification Reminders&quot; as separate actions. Glide&#x27;s Agent is explicitly &quot;experimental.&quot; Bubble&#x27;s AI Agent is &quot;BETA.&quot; Only Manus and Replit attempted to generate the full stack from the prompt, and Replit&#x27;s approach requires more technical comfort to validate and debug.</span></span></span></div></div><div class="w-full mt-[1em] mb-[1px]"><h3 data-slate-node="element" class="font-[600] py-[3px] text-[1.25em]" style="line-height:1.3" data-anchor="buildercomplexityvarieswildly" data-slug="buildercomplexityvarieswildly172"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Builder Complexity Varies Wildly</span></span></span></h3></div><div class="w-full my-[1px]"><div data-slate-node="element" class="py-[3px]"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">The spectrum from &quot;paste a prompt&quot; to &quot;learn a visual programming environment&quot; is enormous. Figma&#x27;s entry point was the cleanest. Lovable and Base44 were similarly approachable. Replit felt developer-friendly but accessible. Other platforms like Lovable and Base44 generate polished frontends quickly, though backend features often require additional setup. The quality depends on how clearly you describe your requirements and the platform you choose.</span></span></span></div></div><div class="w-full mt-[1em] mb-[1px]"><h3 data-slate-node="element" class="font-[600] py-[3px] text-[1.25em]" style="line-height:1.3" data-anchor="howmuchdoesitcosttobuildamobileappusingtheseplatforms%3F" data-slug="howmuchdoesitcosttobuildamobileappusingtheseplatforms%3F205"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">How much does it cost to build a mobile app using these platforms?</span></span></span></h3></div><div class="w-full my-[1px]"><div data-slate-node="element" class="py-[3px]"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Most platforms fall in the $20–$50/month range for their core paid tiers. However, credit-based systems (Lovable, Replit) mean heavy iteration can add to costs. Bubble&#x27;s more advanced tiers range from $29 to $399/month depending on capacity needs. Figma&#x27;s pricing requires contacting sales. For a basic app on a mid-tier platform, expect $20–$100 monthly. Factor in credit consumption for platforms that meter AI usage.</span></span></span></div></div><div class="w-full mt-[1em] mb-[1px]"><h3 data-slate-node="element" class="font-[600] py-[3px] text-[1.25em]" style="line-height:1.3" data-anchor="what&#x27;sthedifferencebetweenageneratedprototypeandaworkingapp%3F" data-slug="what&#x27;sthedifferencebetweenageneratedprototypeandaworkingapp%3F207"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">What&#x27;s the difference between a generated prototype and a working app?</span></span></span></h3></div><div class="w-full my-[1px]"><div data-slate-node="element" class="py-[3px]"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">This was the biggest insight from testing. Most platforms such as Lovable, Base44, Figma, Glide can generate professional-looking mobile interfaces quickly. But a &quot;working app&quot; means the booking calendar actually prevents double-bookings, the payment processing actually charges cards, and the cancellation policy actually calculates refunds. Only Manus and Replit attempted full-stack generation from the prompt; most others generate the visual layer and surface backend features as next steps.</span></span></span></div></div><div class="w-full mt-[1em] mb-[1px]"><h3 data-slate-node="element" class="font-[600] py-[3px] text-[1.25em]" style="line-height:1.3" data-anchor="howlongdoesittaketobuildamobileappontheseplatforms%3F" data-slug="howlongdoesittaketobuildamobileappontheseplatforms%3F209"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">How long does it take to build a mobile app on these platforms?</span></span></span></h3></div><div class="w-full my-[1px]"><div data-slate-node="element" class="py-[3px]"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Using the same Solace Studio prompt across all platforms, initial generation ranged from minutes (Manus, Lovable, Base44) to about 9 minutes of active agent work (Replit). However, &quot;generated&quot; doesn&#x27;t always mean &quot;complete.&quot; Platforms that only generate the frontend require additional time to build backend logic, which could add days or weeks depending on complexity. Bubble&#x27;s full implementation with its workflow engine took the longest due to its learning curve.</span></span></span></div></div><div class="w-full mt-[1em] mb-[1px]"><h3 data-slate-node="element" class="font-[600] py-[3px] text-[1.25em]" style="line-height:1.3" data-anchor="canimigratemyapptoadifferentplatformlater%3F" data-slug="canimigratemyapptoadifferentplatformlater%3F211"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Can I migrate my app to a different platform later?</span></span></span></h3></div><div class="w-full my-[1px]"><div data-slate-node="element" class="py-[3px]"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Migration between platforms is generally difficult. Replit generates real code, giving you the most portability. Figma&#x27;s &quot;Code&quot; toggle suggests export capability. Most other platforms use proprietary structures that don&#x27;t export cleanly. The best approach is choosing the right platform initially based on long-term requirements rather than planning to migrate later.</span></span></span></div></div><div class="w-full mt-[1em] mb-[1px]"><h3 data-slate-node="element" class="font-[600] py-[3px] text-[1.25em]" style="line-height:1.3" data-anchor="whathappensiftheplatformshutsdownorchangespricing%3F" data-slug="whathappensiftheplatformshutsdownorchangespricing%3F213"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">What happens if the platform shuts down or changes pricing?</span></span></span></h3></div><div class="w-full my-[1px]"><div data-slate-node="element" class="py-[3px]"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Platform dependency is a real risk. Replit&#x27;s code generation gives you an escape hatch; you can download and continue development independently. Platforms without code export create vendor lock-in. Choose established platforms with sustainable business models, ensure you can export your data, and for mission-critical applications, prioritize platforms that give you access to the underlying code.</span></span></span></div></div><div class="w-full mt-[1em] mb-[1px]"><h3 data-slate-node="element" class="font-[600] py-[3px] text-[1.25em]" style="line-height:1.3" data-anchor="cantheseplatformshandleappswiththousandsofusers%3F" data-slug="cantheseplatformshandleappswiththousandsofusers%3F215"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Can these platforms handle apps with thousands of users?</span></span></span></h3></div><div class="w-full my-[1px]"><div data-slate-node="element" class="py-[3px]"><span data-slate-node="text"><span class="" style="white-space:break-spaces;word-break:break-word" data-slate-leaf="true"><span data-slate-string="true">Scalability varies. Bubble is designed for large-scale web applications. Replit&#x27;s code-based approach can be deployed to scalable infrastructure. Manus uses cloud infrastructure that scales with usage. Platforms generating progressive web apps (Glide) may hit performance limitations with large concurrent user bases. When evaluating for scale, examine both technical support for scaling and cost implications at your target user count.</span></span></span></div></div></div></div></div><div class="mt-16 lg:mt-[160px]
